selection_process: The selection process consists of an interview only.
how_to_apply: Download the application form annexed with the official notification.
Fill in all the required details in the application form carefully.
Affix a recent passport size photograph on the designated space of the application form.
Self-attest all required documents including application form, certificates, degrees, ID proofs, and DMC registration.

Report directly for the walk-in interview on 13 October 2026 between 9:30 A.M. and 11:00 A.M. at Room No. 304, Establishment Branch, 3rd floor, ABG hospital, Moti Nagar, New Delhi-110015 along with original certificates for verification.
important_instructions: Candidates must report in Room No. 304, Establishment Branch, 3rd floor, ABG hospital, Delhi at 9:30 A.M. to 10:30 A.M. on the date of interview positively to mark their attendance. Candidates must bring all original certificates at the time of interview to verify by Members of Selection Board. Adhoc candidates' period will be 89 days extendable for a maximum period of three years, including the ad-hoc period or till the joining of Regular/Specialist Doctors whichever is earlier. No TA/DA will be paid to the candidates called for the interview. Selected candidates shall be allowed to join within 07 working days from the issue of the offer letter failing which the offer shall stand automatically cancelled. OBC/EWS certificates issued from Govt. of NCT of Delhi shall only be accepted. OBC candidates must have a valid Non-Creamy Layer Certificate for the current financial year. Appointment shall be subject to medical fitness by the Staff Physician of ABGH. The decision of the Medical Superintendent will be final in case of any legal dispute.
